closed_world_policy.default_candidate_space: Use only the 20 active Analysis Problem values and the selected Layer 2 topic's listed methods for ordinary selection tasks.
closed_world_policy.external_package_exception: If the user explicitly requests a method, package, paper, or update outside the registry, mark out_of_formal_review and do not silently merge it into ordinary Layer 1/2 selection.
agent_must_not: promote backbone workflow packages into method-table candidates unless the topic file says so
claim default methods or execution readiness

workflow: Parse the user's scientific object and target output.
Select the Layer 1 Analysis Problem from knowledge_registry/layer1/task_catalog.md.
Use main input or signal only to break ties after object and output are considered.
Open the exact Layer 2 route listed for the selected Analysis Problem.
Use the Layer 2 Problem boundary, Method feature table, and Decision tree for branch-local method selection.
Return a bounded handoff with route, rationale, candidate methods, caveats, and out_of_formal status.
tie_breaking: Prefer scientific object and target output over package names.
Split multi-endpoint requests into multiple Layer 1 routes.
Ask for clarification when route ambiguity changes the method candidate set.
Keep benchmark or review evidence branch-local; do not convert it into a universal all-method ranking.
